coverage.note: Reviewed current official sources; excluded end-of-date or removed postings, expressions of interest and listings outside Melbourne. Kraken roles state that existing Australian work authorization is required.

Excluded internships, citizenship-only public-sector roles, wrong locations and currently unavailable direct postings. Some selected postings give priority to people with existing Singapore work authorization.

Retained advertised cities and excluded postings requiring Chinese or Mandarin; English-language listings do not establish work rights or sponsorship. EPAM’s separately indexed backend posting redirected to its main jobs page and was excluded.

duplicate_exclusions.reason: Shares verified requisition 61 with Full Stack Developer; retain the closer-fit title once.
